intro: Jacksonville listings advertise non-climate 10x10 units from about $49, while typical non-climate 10x10 street rates run about $107 in the city and $116 across the metro. Rents are down year over year — the metro asking rent fell about 14% — and a large block of new storage is due in 2026. The banner price is still not the six-month price once fees and the first existing-customer increase land.
data_asof: Sep–Oct 2026 (StorageCafe, Storage Stats). StorageUnitCosts does not publish a Jacksonville city page.

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. Estimate: single source (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). Climate-controlled ~$53; climate promos from about $16.
Walk-in closet; studio overflow. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap). Estimate: single source (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). Climate-controlled ~$79.
Most rented size. City average $107, down 1.8% YoY (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). Jacksonville metro averages $116, down 14.1% YoY (Storage Stats). Climate-controlled ~$124.
Two-bedroom contents. Estimate: single source (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). Climate-controlled ~$165.
Three-bedroom home or a car. Estimate: single source (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). Climate-controlled ~$217.

local_tips: Location drives price: StorageCafe lists Woodland Acres (~$87), Northbank (~$88) and Cedar Hills Estates (~$94) among the cheapest areas, while Spring Glen (~$355) and Southpoint (~$282) run highest.
Outside the city, a non-climate 10x10 street rate is about $83 in Middleburg and $99 on Fleming Island, against about $129 in Jacksonville Beach and $152 in Fernandina Beach (StorageCafe, Sep 2026).
Jacksonville rates tend to be lowest around December and highest in October (StorageCafe). The seasonal swing in the all-units average is only a few dollars.

About 726,000 sq ft of new storage is due in Jacksonville in 2026, up about 36% from 2025 (StorageCafe). The city already has about 10.1 sq ft per capita, so ask a new facility what month 5 costs before taking the move-in special.
StorageUnitCosts, which tracks 20 major cities, does not publish a Jacksonville page. Size rates other than the 10x10 are StorageCafe only.
Extra Space's published example admin fee is $50, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more (StorageUnitCosts).
